scientific_integrity: Claim limited to exact maximum inverse-list size and equality profiles; finite checker is corroborative and no independent assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete multiplicity-preserving unordered binary adjacent-pair observations only, linear n>=3, no errors or omissions; individual profile-count technique known from prior literature. A classical unindexed Markov-type optimizer remains a possible originality overlap.
title: Sharp binary two-read multiset reconstruction-list bound and extremal profiles
